name: Tahat
title: Descendants of Ephraim
summary: Tahat is a person mentioned in the Bible as a descendant of Ephraim, Joseph's son. He appears in the genealogies in 1 Chronicles. There are at least two individuals with this name in Ephraim's lineage, indicating the use of the name within this tribe.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Ephraim's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Tahat is listed as the son of Bered in the genealogy of the tribe of Ephraim, as part of the ancestral line from Ephraim.

keyEvents.title: Father of Elada
keyEvents.description: Tahat was the father of Eladah, thus continuing the lineage of Ephraim to the next generation.

keyEvents.title: Part of the tribe of Ephraim
keyEvents.description: As descendants of Ephraim, Tahat belonged to one of the twelve tribes of Israel, with roots tracing back to the patriarch Joseph and his father Jacob.

keyEvents.title: Another Tahat in the same lineage
keyEvents.description: There is another Tahat mentioned in the same genealogy, who was the son of Eladah, showing that the name was reused within the family.
